## WF7 ClickUp sync
Reads Leads and Actions, updates the ClickUp list "Mail Atılan Kurumlar – Müşteri Listesi". One task per company (second-contact rows L123-B go to the parent task). Match: Lead ID field, then email, then exact name.

**Config node**
- dry_run true = plan only, nothing written (see Run summary output)
- overwrite_hand_filled false = the 8 fields Nil filled by hand are only filled when empty; differences are listed, not written
- only_lead_ids = comma list for a test on a few companies

Each new Actions row becomes a dated comment; the row then gets a ClickUp Comment ID so it is posted once.
